purpose: Freeze T12-owned stable identities, authority boundaries and runtime responsibilities that do not depend on unresolved or activation-unverified T10/T11 concrete IDs.

fact_slot.rule: Level 1 is intrinsically ready and does not require its fact slot; Levels 2-100 each reference exactly the matching fact-slot identity.

T12_owns: progression level identity and prerequisite topology
component-local deterministic reconstruction data for later T14 integration
fact-slot identity and binding requirements that map external authoritative facts into progression eligibility
T12_reads_but_never_mutates: later content-owner completion facts registered through approved bindings
T12_never_owns: T13 adaptive difficulty or Challenge Director decisions

requirements: load progression_bindings_v1.json as the canonical resolved_binding_index
fail closed on malformed IDs/topology/binding rows
allow explicitly deferred later-content bindings while keeping affected levels locked
external producer IDs never appear directly in progression level records

observe_authoritative_fact.result: zero or more ordered T12 progression intents after retaining newly satisfied fact slots and settling newly completable levels
requirements: accept only RESOLVED binding rows matching source_task + fact_kind + source_id
map accepted facts into one or more stable T12 fact slots through the binding index
retain satisfied fact slots even when prerequisites are not yet complete; never skip prerequisites
combine binding idempotency_domain with producer idempotency_key; duplicate domain/key is no-op
settle newly completable levels in ascending deterministic order
does not define global save/version schema
no telemetry or purchase signal affects progression eligibility

progression_intent_contract.intent_id_rule: exact t12.intent.level.NNN.completed derived only from the completed level identity; replay produces the same identity and no second publication

field_semantics.intent_id: exact deterministic t12.intent.level.NNN.completed identity for the completed level; replay never republishes it
field_semantics.level_id: the T12 level completed by this transition
field_semantics.completion_event_id: the canonical t12.event.level.NNN.completed identity recorded before the intent is returned
field_semantics.unlocked_level_ids: direct dependent level IDs whose prerequisite sets became complete because of this completion; these levels may still remain fact-locked and are not implicitly complete
field_semantics.milestone_ids: milestones attached to the completed level and recorded exactly once before the intent is returned
field_semantics.source_fact_keys: domain-scoped consumed authoritative fact keys that satisfied the completed level's required T12 fact slots; empty for the intrinsic Level 1 baseline

component_state_contract.reconstruction_rule: Restoring the same accepted T12-local snapshot against the same resolved bindings produces the same completed/unlocked state while preserving satisfied fact slots, fact-slot source-key causality, consumed fact keys and emitted IDs, without re-emitting already-recorded completion or milestone events; deterministic settlement may finish an interrupted ready transition.

performance_contract.evaluation: event-driven or explicit query; no per-frame traversal of all 100 levels when nothing changed

activation_rule: T12 may implement the frozen fact-slot architecture only after activation. Exact T10/T11 source IDs remain external to progression data and must be supplied through separately verified BINDING_RESOLUTION.json and the trusted runtime binding index.

fact_slot_binding_contract.shipping_level_rule: Level 1 required_fact_ids is empty; Levels 2-100 each contain exactly the matching t12.fact.slot.NNN and no external producer ID.
fact_slot_binding_contract.resolved_rule: RESOLVED entries identify an accepted authoritative producer fact and may satisfy the slot when observed.
fact_slot_binding_contract.deferred_rule: DEFERRED_LATER_OWNER is allowed only for content owned by later tasks; the stable slot remains valid but the level stays locked until an integration-owned registration resolves it.
fact_slot_binding_contract.t10_t11_rule: Any T10/T11 source_id used by the binding index must come from the exact activation-time BINDING_RESOLUTION.json proof.
fact_slot_binding_contract.authority_rule: T12 owns slot identity and eligibility interpretation, never the upstream fact itself.
fact_slot_binding_contract.presentation_requirement_rule: visible_progression_required and major_milestone_completed are T12 architecture/presentation requirements only; they can never be registered as authoritative fact sources or satisfy t12.fact.slot.NNN.
fact_slot_binding_contract.idempotency_rule: Every RESOLVED binding has a non-empty idempotency_domain; observe_authoritative_fact combines that domain with the authoritative producer key so duplicates are deterministic no-ops.
fact_slot_binding_contract.evidence_rule: Every RESOLVED binding carries an evidence_ref proving the trusted producer authority/source. DEFERRED_LATER_OWNER rows carry later-owner provenance but no fake source_id.
fact_slot_binding_contract.opening_activation_rule: Levels 3,4,6,9,10 are activation-critical opening slots and must be RESOLVED when T12 materializes shipping data; across those rows the binding set must consume at least one accepted T10 fact and at least one accepted T11 fact.

transition_semantics.fresh_initialization: Level 1 has no prerequisites/fact gate, so deterministic settlement completes the baseline Level 1 once and emits its canonical completion intent/event exactly once.
transition_semantics.authoritative_observation: A valid RESOLVED producer fact first records its domain-scoped idempotency key and matching satisfied_fact_slot_ids, then runs deterministic ascending settlement.
transition_semantics.out_of_order_fact: A valid fact whose level prerequisite is not yet complete is retained as a satisfied fact slot. The level remains locked and can never skip prerequisites; after its prerequisite later completes, settlement may complete the retained-ready level without requiring the producer to replay the fact.
transition_semantics.invalid_or_deferred_fact: Unknown, ambiguous, mismatched, or DEFERRED_LATER_OWNER producer facts fail closed and do not mutate T12 state.
transition_semantics.settlement: Repeatedly scan levels in numeric ascending order until no new completion occurs. A level completes only when every prerequisite_level_id is complete and every ID in required_fact_ids is a satisfied T12 fact slot.
transition_semantics.intent_order: Completion intents are emitted in ascending level order. Completion and milestone IDs are recorded before returning intents so replay/restore cannot double-emit them.
transition_semantics.restore: Restore validates all stable IDs. It never re-emits already-recorded completion or milestone IDs; an interrupted snapshot with satisfied slots but incomplete now-ready levels may be deterministically settled.
